description: The last page of the TTD board packet for December 2, 2026, which carries the first Tentative Agenda Planning Calendar in TTD's three-committee grid layout (item VII): RTCP Committee, Finance & Personnel Committee, and Board of Directors columns with numbered rows and an Agenda section column, under a staff-report footer; stored document_pages text (public agency document, excerpted for tests).
